rules.statement: A fraudulent alienation can be set aside by a creditor who had an ex-delicto cause of action and notified the intention to bring an action, even if the alienor was not insolvent at the time of the alienation.
rules.supporting_quote: "In fact the second defendant was deliberately rendering himself insolvent as against the time that the decree would come into being. In the result, the claim of the first defendant has been defeated."
